query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026
queries: Massachusetts unemployment maximum weekly benefit amount 2026

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the **maximum unemployment benefit is $1,105 per week** for regular unemployment insurance claims, as of the current Mass.gov information. Benefits are generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, up to that cap. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

You may also get an extra **$25 per dependent child per week**, but the dependency allowance is capped at **50% of your weekly benefit amount**. Massachusetts generally allows up to **30 weeks** of benefits. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))

So, if you qualify for the maximum:
- **Weekly max:** $1,105  
- **Up to 30 weeks:** $33,150 total before any dependency allowance or reductions  
- With maximum dependency allowance, the weekly amount could be higher, depending on your situation.
